attributes.action: Gain funding to support young pupils mental health in UK schools.
attributes.additional_details:
1/3 of young adults have admitted to having self harm or suicidal thoughts.
30% of student with a mental health condition have missed one or more weeks of school since 2022. 74% of teachers have stated poor mental health is the main factor preventing students from learning.
Providing funding for schools would help support students and improve their mental health.
attributes.background: Currently, 1 in 5 students have a mental disorder and only a fifth receive support. By signing this petition you will help gain the government's attention, which would then lead to more funding in school to help young peoples mental health.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We understand that you would like the Government to provide funding to support students' mental health, but we're not sure exactly what specific services you'd like to be funded.

You may wish to sign the following:

Mandate all schools in England to have an SLT member trained for mental health
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776281

Mandate Mental Health Training for All School Staff Who Work With Children
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/752343

Fund student support centres in every school
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768561
